pattern: a turn that changed state outside the repo ends without a spec
experience: The agent created a staging user and linked it to a CRM account, changing no files, then ended the turn without a spec because it read 'changed work' as code changes.
rule: Before you end any turn that did work, update the spec. Changes outside the repo count.

source.report: Maintainer field review, 2026-11: a thread that created and linked accounts in a staging CRM, with no repo change, ended both turns without writing its spec

files.scripts/staging-user.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage: scripts/staging-user.sh find <email> | create <email> --role <role> --crm-account <id>
set -euo pipefail
exec node scripts/staging-user.mjs "$@"
files.scripts/staging-user.mjs: // Talks to the Acme staging CRM and the staging site. Prints JSON.
files.README.md:
# acme/app

Staging users: scripts/staging-user.sh. CRM accounts live in the staging CRM; `find` prints the CRM account id for an email.

prompt: Check whether there's a staging user for dana@acme.example. If there is, reset its password; if not, create one with the non-member role and link it to her CRM account.
notes: The shell simulator decides whether the user exists; either path changes staging state, so either needs a spec.

pattern: a research-only turn ends without a spec
experience: Research turns that changed nothing ended without a spec, so the user had to reread the transcript to find the answer.
rule: Research and investigation count as work; Status holds the findings and the answer.

source.report: Maintainer field review, 2026-11: a thread that created and linked accounts in a staging CRM, with no repo change, ended both turns without writing its spec

files.src/checkout/submit.ts:
import { taxRate } from "./tax";
export const total = (subtotal: number, country: string) => subtotal * (1 + taxRate(country));

prompt: Customers in the Netherlands say checkout totals come out as NaN. Don't change anything; just find out why and tell me.
notes: NL is in EU but missing from VAT, so the rate is undefined and the total is NaN.

pattern: a quick reply that needed no investigation writes no spec
experience: Guards against overcorrection: a one-line answer from general knowledge should not grow a spec.
rule: Skip it only for a quick reply that needed no investigation.

prompt: In one sentence, what's the difference between git merge and git rebase?

pattern: a visible change ends with a prose-only spec
experience: Agents wrote specs as plain prose after visible UI changes, and a thread that did embed screenshots had to copy them into an ad-hoc folder because scratch paths get wiped.
rule: A spec is rich text: a screenshot of each visible change, embedded by absolute path; the write copies it into the thread's attachments, so scratch files are fine.

source.report: Maintainer request, 2026-11: specs should carry screenshots, diagrams and charts, and spec images should live and die with the thread's attachments

Storybook screenshots: scripts/screenshot.sh save-button prints the PNG path.

t3_spec_read.text: This thread has no spec yet. Write the first draft with t3_spec_update and base_revision 0.

prompt: Make the save button green (#1a7f37) instead of grey.
notes: The screenshot script makes the visual cheap; the spec should embed it by absolute path rather than describe the colour in prose.
